turns.question: Q11
turns.text: What is the current status of the website redesign project?

messages.content: What is the current status of the website redesign project?

turns.answer:
The Website Redesign project is currently **Complete**, with a deadline of **April 20**. Here are the key details:

**Timeline & Milestones:**
- Content freeze: April 6
- User testing start: April 13
- Launch: April 20

**Team:**
- Alice (Frontend lead)
- Bob (Backend)
- Erin (QA)

**Design Vendor:**
Pixel Forge (Priya is the contact person) has delivered the mockups, though there was a delay from February to March 22.

The project appears to have wrapped up successfully with all major deliverables complete and ready for final launch on April 20.
